entries.title: Vivid Pulse has its own home
changes: Vivid Pulse moved to its own GitHub repository (Jambo199/VividPulse) and now updates from there
Nothing else changed: your settings and starred games carry over

entries.title: Updates that find you, game search and more
changes: When a new version is out, a card slides up above the tabs: tap Update, watch it download, then confirm the install
After updating, a What's new sheet lists the changes (also in Settings)
The app checks for updates when it opens and every few hours while it's open
Search any game on Steam and see its live player count, price and page
Star games to keep their live player counts in Your games on the Games page, and share any game
Battery page: this charge at a glance (time, % gained, % per hour, peak watts, energy) or drain since unplugged
Speed test shows which Cloudflare server and provider you're on, can share the result, and taps when done
Live header shows how long the phone has been on and how much of that it slept
Option to keep the screen on while the app is open

entries.title: Little fixes
changes: Placeholder clock speeds some phones report are ignored
Deal end dates are tidier
A clear message when the phone lists no cameras

entries.title: Readable text everywhere, and fixes from the first screenshots
changes: Text is readable everywhere on the dark theme
Clock speeds a phone hides show as hidden, not 0 MHz
Core bars stay slim whatever the number of cores
The speed test needle no longer crosses the number in the middle
Pages opened from shortcuts start fresh
Tidier player charts, HDR brightness and speed test history

entries.title: The first Vivid Pulse
changes: Live: CPU activity per core, RAM, GPU, battery (watts and temperature), heat, network speed and storage, with smooth charts, springy gauges and cards that grow into detail pages
Device: full specs, from the system and chip to display modes and HDR, cameras, sensors with live readings and features like Wi-Fi 7 and NFC
Games: Steam's top 20 most played with live player counts, weekly top sellers, deals, Epic's free games and a page for each game
Tools: speed test, smoothness meter, dead pixel and touch tests and a vibration check
Launcher shortcuts, and an updater built in
